source_caption:
Here’s your first look at Tom Cruise in Alejandro G. Iñárritu’s DIGGER.

The original film stars Cruise as the world’s most powerful man, who embarks on a desperate mission to prove he’s humanity’s savior before the disaster he unleashed destroys everything.

Written and directed by Academy Award winner Alejandro G. Iñárritu, the film also stars Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, Jesse Plemons, Emma D’Arcy, Sophie Wilde, Burn Gorman, and Robert John Burke.

Shot entirely in VistaVision, DIGGER arrives in theaters and IMAX on October 2, 2026.

source_details.title: Digger
source_details.synopsis: Digger is a 2026 American satirical black comedy film co-written, directed, and co-produced by Alejandro González Iñárritu. Tom Cruise, who also produced the film, stars in the role of Digger Rockwell, an aging oil magnate whose drilling sets off an ecological disaster. The supporting cast includes Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, Robert John Burke, Emma D'Arcy, Burn Gorman, Sophie Wilde and Jesse Plemons. Iñárritu conceived the idea for Digger after working on The Revenant (2015).
